metadata.title: Tislelizumab and Modified FOLFOX-6 Therapy
metadata.indication: First-line unresectable locally advanced or metastatic oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma with PD-L1 TAP ≥5%.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or other appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00925 Version 1. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.label: Worst relevant non-haematological toxicity

options.label: Grade 0 — No toxicity
options.description: No other non-haematological adverse event.

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: Grade 1 under the named CTCAE term: generally mild or asymptomatic, with observation only and no intervention indicated.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: Grade 2 under the named CTCAE term: generally moderate; local/non-invasive intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: Grade 3 under the named CTCAE term: severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 4 — Life-threatening
options.description: Grade 4 under the named CTCAE term: life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the exact adverse event and use its toxicity-specific CTCAE definition; assess symptoms, intervention and functional impact before selecting the grade.

diarrhoea_grade.label: Diarrhoea grade

options.label: Grade 0 — No toxicity
options.description: No increase above the patient's usual stool frequency or ostomy output.

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: Increase of fewer than 4 stools per day above baseline, or mild increase in ostomy output.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: Increase of 4–6 stools per day above baseline, or moderate increase in ostomy output; limits instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: Increase of 7 or more stools per day above baseline, incontinence, hospital care indicated, or severe ostomy-output increase; limits self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4 — Life-threatening
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

diarrhoea_grade.assessment_guidance: Grade using increase in stools over baseline, ostomy output, need for hospitalisation and impact on self-care; do not grade from the word “diarrhoea” alone.

mucositis_grade.label: Oral mucositis/stomatitis grade

options.label: Grade 0 — No toxicity
options.description: No oral mucositis.

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: Asymptomatic or mild symptoms; intervention not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: Moderate pain or ulceration that does not interfere with oral intake; modified diet indicated.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: Severe pain that interferes with oral intake.

options.label: Grade 4 — Life-threatening
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

mucositis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess pain, ulceration and whether oral intake is preserved, modified or impossible.

neuropathy_grade.label: Peripheral sensory neuropathy grade

options.label: Grade 0 — No toxicity
options.description: No peripheral sensory or motor neuropathy.

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: Asymptomatic; clinical or diagnostic observations only. CTCAE v5.0 grades symptomatic paraesthesia separately when that is the more accurate term.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: Moderate symptoms that limit instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: Severe symptoms that limit self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4 — Life-threatening
options.description: Life-threatening neurological consequences; urgent intervention required.

neuropathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Grade by symptoms and functional impact: instrumental ADL limitation is grade 2; self-care ADL limitation is grade 3.

oxaliplatin_renal_band.label: Renal function for oxaliplatin
oxaliplatin_renal_band.help_text: Select the protocol-relevant renal band; no exact value is required unless another drug needs it.

pneumonitis_grade.label: Pneumonitis grade

options.label: Grade 0 — No toxicity
options.description: No pneumonitis.

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: Asymptomatic; clinical or diagnostic observations only; intervention not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: Symptomatic; medical intervention indicated; limits instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: Severe symptoms; oxygen indicated; limits self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4 — Life-threatening
options.description: Life-threatening respiratory compromise; urgent intervention such as ventilatory support required.

pneumonitis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess symptoms, oxygen requirement, imaging extent and impact on activities of daily living.

diarrhoea_colitis_grade.label: Immune-mediated diarrhoea/colitis grade

options.label: Grade 0 — No toxicity
options.description: Neither diarrhoea nor colitis is present.

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: Diarrhoea: fewer than 4 stools/day above baseline or mild ostomy-output increase. Colitis: asymptomatic, clinical/diagnostic observations only.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: Diarrhoea: 4-6 stools/day above baseline or moderate ostomy-output increase; limits instrumental ADL. Colitis: abdominal pain or mucus/blood in stool.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: Diarrhoea: at least 7 stools/day above baseline, incontinence, hospitalisation or severe ostomy-output increase; limits self-care ADL. Colitis: severe abdominal pain or peritoneal signs.

options.label: Grade 4 — Life-threatening
options.description: Life-threatening diarrhoea or colitis; urgent intervention required.

diarrhoea_colitis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess stool increase over baseline, abdominal symptoms, bleeding, hospitalisation and peritoneal signs.

creatinine_ratio_baseline_or_uln.label: Creatinine ratio versus baseline or local ULN

alt_ast_uln_multiple.label: ALT / AST result (actual values entered; highest ×ULN calculated automatically)

bilirubin_uln_multiple.label: Bilirubin result (actual value entered; ×ULN calculated automatically)

cortisol_nmol_l.label: Cortisol (optional; interpret by sample time and steroid exposure)

myocarditis_or_neurological_red_flags.label: Possible myocarditis, myositis, encephalitis or acute neurological red flags

infusion_reaction_grade.label: Infusion-related reaction grade

options.label: Grade 0 — No toxicity
options.description: No infusion-related or hypersensitivity reaction.

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: Mild transient reaction; interruption of the infusion is not indicated; intervention not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: Infusion interruption or treatment is indicated, with prompt response to symptomatic medication; prophylaxis may be needed for 24 hours or less.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: Prolonged symptoms not rapidly responsive to treatment/brief interruption, or recurrence after initial improvement; hospitalisation indicated for clinical sequelae.

options.label: Grade 4 — Life-threatening
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

infusion_reaction_grade.assessment_guidance: Grade by required interruption, treatment, recurrence, hospitalisation and life-threatening features.

output_templates.omit: Omit the relevant scheduled dose and reassess according to the official NCCP pathway.
output_templates.contraindicated: The entered value triggers an encoded contraindication/exclusion.
output_templates.permanently_discontinue: The entered value triggers permanent discontinuation in the encoded pathway.
